title: DFA for ab or ba
goal: Show a total DFA over a and b that accepts exactly the two words ab and ba.

rubric.must: The initial marker visibly enters Start and Accept is visibly marked accepting.
Visible labelled paths Start-a-SeenA-b-Accept and Start-b-SeenB-a-Accept exist.
Each visible state has an outgoing transition labelled a and an outgoing transition labelled b.
Dead is visible with both a and b self-transitions.
SeenA on a and SeenB on b visibly go to Dead.
